overrides: Advisories against packages Expo 51 and React Native 0.74 pull in. npm's
own remedy for every one of them is `expo@57`/`react-native@0.87` — a
major upgrade this project has not scheduled — so these pin the patched
transitive version instead. A stopgap, not the fix: see 'Known Gaps' in
Only ONE of these ships to users. decode-uri-component is reached at
runtime through query-string <- @react-navigation/core, and its code is
in the exported web bundle (verified by grepping for its own regexes).
The rest — tar, postcss, ajv, uuid, fast-xml-parser, @xmldom/xmldom,
send — are Expo CLI, Metro, the RN native-prebuild tooling and the dev
static server. They run on the machine that builds, never in a browser.
image-size is deliberately absent: every published version including the
latest (2.0.2) is in the advisory's vulnerable range, so there is nothing
to pin. It is Metro's, build-time only, and clears with the RN upgrade.
Verified by `npm test` and `expo export --platform web`. Those do NOT
exercise `expo prebuild` or an EAS native build, which is where forcing
majors into @expo/plist, xcode and the RN CLI would show up first.
